message: The other day, our family group chat was buzzing with storm updates, and I couldn’t help but chuckle at the mix of emojis and advice flying around. It’s nice to know we’re all looking out for each other, but I realized that some practical tips wouldn’t hurt—especially when it comes to floods. Sharing useful resources helps us stay prepared without the panic. What’s your go-to storm tip when the skies turn gray? ☔
